| [`mainframe.host`](/docs/registry/mainframe/entities.md#mainframehost) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | A mainframe host, representing the physical machine known as the Central Processing Complex (CPC) — the mainframe equivalent of a bare-metal server. |
| [`mainframe.nic`](/docs/registry/mainframe/entities.md#mainframenic) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | A virtual network interface card (NIC) attached to a logical partition (LPAR) in Dynamic Partition Manager (DPM) mode — the mainframe equivalent of a vNIC attached to a virtual machine. |
| [`mainframe.partition`](/docs/registry/mainframe/entities.md#mainframepartition) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | A logical partition (LPAR) running on the mainframe — the mainframe equivalent of a virtual machine (VM). | [`mainframe.port`](/docs/registry/mainframe/entities.md#mainframeport) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | A physical port on a mainframe network adapter in Dynamic Partition Manager (DPM) mode — the mainframe equivalent of a physical port on a multi-port NIC or switch. |
| [`mainframe.storage.group`](/docs/registry/mainframe/entities.md#mainframestoragegroup) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | A DPM storage group — a named collection of block storage volumes of a single connectivity type (FCP, FC, or NVMe) that can be attached to one or more DPM partitions. Analogous to a Kubernetes StorageClass or a cloud storage pool. |
| [`mainframe.storage.volume`](/docs/registry/mainframe/entities.md#mainframestoragevolume) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | A DPM storage volume — a single unit of block storage (LUN, ECKD DASD cylinder set, or NVMe namespace) within a storage group. Analogous to a Kubernetes Persistent Volume or a cloud block storage volume. |

**[1] `mainframe.adapter.name`:** The channel subsystem (CSS) index and channel path identifier (CHPID) are concatenated with a dot separator, e.g., "0.2D" for CSS 0, CHPID 2D. Reported by the HMC Web Services API adapter object field `adapter-id`.

**[2] `mainframe.adapter.owning.partition`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API adapter object. Set to 'shared' when the adapter is not dedicated to a single partition.

**[3] `mainframe.adapter.status`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API adapter object field `status` (DPM mode).

**[4] `mainframe.adapter.type`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API adapter object field `type`. Used to distinguish network, storage, cryptographic, and accelerator adapters when aggregating per-type utilization metrics.

**[5] `mainframe.channel.name`:** The channel subsystem (CSS) index and channel path identifier (CHPID) are concatenated with a dot separator, e.g., "0.2D" for CSS 0, CHPID 2D. Reported by the HMC Web Services API channel-path object.

**[6] `mainframe.channel.owning.partition`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API channel-path object. Set to 'shared' when the channel is not dedicated to a single partition.

**[7] `mainframe.cpu.name`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API processor object. In distributed systems terms, a mainframe processor is analogous to a physical CPU core.

**[8] `mainframe.host.machine_model`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API CPC object field `machine-model`. Combined with `mainframe.host.machine_type`, forms the full IBM machine type-model identifier (e.g., "9175-ME1").

**[9] `mainframe.host.machine_type`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API CPC object field `machine-type`. In distributed systems terms, this is analogous to the CPU family or server product line identifier.

**[10] `mainframe.host.serial_number`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API CPC object field `serial-number`. The serial number uniquely identifies a physical mainframe machine.

**[11] `mainframe.nic.name`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API partition-attached-network-interface metric group. In distributed systems terms, this is analogous to a virtual NIC (vNIC) attached to a virtual machine.

**[12] `mainframe.partition.memory.type`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API partition object storage allocation properties. Central storage is equivalent to RAM; expanded storage is an additional address extension beyond central storage. IBM Virtual Flash Memory (VFM) is a solid-state tier extending the memory address space.

**[13] `mainframe.partition.name`:** A logical partition (LPAR) is the mainframe equivalent of a virtual machine (VM) in distributed cloud environments. Each LPAR can run an independent operating system such as z/OS, Linux, or z/VM. Reported by the HMC Web Services API partition object field `name`.

**[14] `mainframe.partition.status`:** In classic mode (LPAR), reported by the HMC Web Services API partition object field `status` with values: operating, not-operating, not-activated, exceptions. In DPM mode, reported with values: active, degraded, paused, stopped, starting, stopping, reservation-error, terminated, communications-not-active, status-check.

**[15] `mainframe.port.id`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API network-physical-adapter-port metric group field `network-port-id`. In distributed systems terms, this is analogous to the port number on a multi-port NIC.

**[16] `mainframe.storage.fulfillment.state`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API storage-group or storage-volume object field `fulfillment-state` (DPM mode only, HMC ≥ 2.14.1). In distributed systems terms, this is analogous to the binding phase of a Kubernetes Persistent Volume Claim.

**[17] `mainframe.storage.group.name`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API storage-group resource object field `name` (DPM mode only, HMC ≥ 2.14.1). A storage group aggregates storage volumes of the same connectivity type (FCP, FC, NVMe) that are managed together and can be attached to partitions.

**[18] `mainframe.storage.group.type`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API storage-group object field `type` (DPM mode only, HMC ≥ 2.14.1).

**[19] `mainframe.storage.volume.name`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API storage-volume resource object field `name` (DPM mode only, HMC ≥ 2.14.1). A storage volume is a single logical unit of block storage (LUN / ECKD DASD cylinder set / NVMe namespace) within a storage group.
